scope: with an entity present the ps block starts at bit 1343 - i.e. exactly where the entity section ends, past the count1 body
reading: the entity loop consumes up to bit 1342; the ps block therefore starts at 1343
clearing the stream error at 0x471A36 works (record shows before=1), so the block is entered
but it can only read one bit because the count1 body ends at 1352 bits and its remaining bits are the old tail, not a ps block
so an A=1 body must be rebuilt as: entity section (bits 0..1342) + ps block + the original tail bits (1343..1351)
